title: VCS Downloader Flow
interaction_flow: VcsDownloader → PackageInterface: getSourceReference() — throws if missing
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: prepareUrls(urls) — resolves local paths via realpath()
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: doDownload(package, path, url, prevPackage?) [abstract, per-VCS impl]
alt doDownload fails and more URLs remain
VcsDownloader → IOInterface: writeError('Failed, trying next URL')
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: doDownload(package, path, nextUrl, prevPackage?) [retry loop]
InstallationManager → VcsDownloader: prepare('update', package, path, prevPackage)
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: cleanChanges(prevPackage, path, true) — stash local changes
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: doUpdate(initial, target, path, url) [abstract]
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: throw RuntimeException('Could not delete path')
InstallationManager → VcsDownloader: cleanup('update', package, path, prevPackage)
VcsDownloader → VcsDownloader: reapplyChanges(path) — re-applies stashed changes
key_relationships: VcsDownloader implements DownloaderInterface (download, prepare, install, update, remove, cleanup)
VcsDownloader depends_on PackageInterface (getSourceReference, getSourceUrls, getPrettyName, getUniqueName)
GitDownloader/SvnDownloader/HgDownloader extend VcsDownloader (implement doDownload, doInstall, doUpdate, getCommitLogs, hasMetadataRepository, getLocalChanges)
error_handling: download(): catches Exception per URL, retries next URL, rethrows on last URL; rethrows PHPUnit exceptions immediately
install(): same retry pattern as download()
update(): same retry pattern; stores last exception and rethrows if no URLs remain
remove(): Promise rejection if removeDirectoryAsync returns false
cleanChanges(): default throws RuntimeException if getLocalChanges() != null (override in subclass for stash support)
download/install: if getSourceReference() is null → throws InvalidArgumentException immediately
promise_pattern: All public methods return React\Promise\PromiseInterface. Async operations use Promise chaining (removeDirectoryAsync().then(...)). Most methods resolve(null) synchronously after sync work.
important_notes: VcsDownloader is abstract — concrete implementations are GitDownloader, SvnDownloader, HgDownloader. The 3-phase lifecycle is: download (fetch data) → prepare (stash/clean) → install|update|remove (apply). cleanup() is always called after to reapply stashed changes. prepareUrls() handles file:// protocol and URL-encoding for local paths.
